messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: INC-2026-447 Smart routing fallback loop detected for cluster-us / org_42. Elevated error rate and latency spikes since ~1799991220. Symptoms: request routing oscillating across regions, unexpected model_variant 'gpt-legacy-quant' serving for production traffic. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/smart-routing

sre-oncall: I’m on it. paging into #incidents and #eng-runtime. Starting triage, gathering logs.

alice: seeing many 502/503s in the global proxy logs, but some requests succeeded with very high latency (3s+). Looks correlated with region-fallback events.

ben: quick note — traffic route tags are missing in a chunk of decision logs. That makes it hard to trace which policy branch fired.

carol: @sre-oncall any idea why 'gpt-legacy-quant' is being chosen? that model was deprecated for prod weeks ago.

sre-oncall: hypothesis: fallback policy matched a generic variant when the preferred variant was unavailable. but the fallback loop suggests policy evaluated region -> variant -> fallback -> reroute back to same policy. need decision logs.

eng-runtime: digging into router logs. decision_log entries are truncated for >1000 chars in some shards; looks like the route_tag and policy_id fields are null in those entries. Paging @dinesh — you pushed the last policy change right?

dinesh: yes I merged a small policy refactor earlier today to make policy matching less strict. I did NOT touch default fallbacks. Will review the PR now.

product-ops: customer-alerting: two customers (acct-720, acct-901) reported degraded completion quality and latency; sales notified. We should assess impact window and list affected orgs.

ben: re: observability gaps — the decision logger config got toggled to 'trim' mode during the infra deploy; that explains missing route tags. Might be a config drift between regions.

alice: mitigation idea: disable smart-routing policy globally to stop churn, and pin traffic to last-known-good model_variant for org_42. That buys time.

sre-oncall: agreed — performing quick mitigation: 1) set routing.policy.smart_routing.enabled=false for cluster-us and cluster-eu via admin API; 2) pin org_42 to model_variant 'gpt-4o-prod' with rollout=100.

eng-runtime: command ready, copy for audit:
```
# disable smart routing
curl -X POST
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
  -d '{"policy.smart_routing.enabled":false}'
  https://api.internal.redwood/configs/cluster-us

# pin model variant
curl -X POST
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
  -d '{"org_id":"org_42","model_variant":"gpt-4o-prod","rollout":100}'
  https://api.internal.redwood/route_pins
```

carol: executing disable now on cluster-us. I'll watch for stabilization metrics.

sre-oncall: cluster-us disabled. CPU and 5xxs dropping. latency improving for pinned org_42.

eng-runtime: applying same to cluster-eu now. Also toggling decision_log max_size to 8192 for all routers to avoid truncation.

dinesh: found the policy refactor bug — if policy.matchers list is empty due to a null tag, fallback picks the first available variant in the catalog (which included the legacy quantized model). Preparing a hotfix to explicitly exclude deprecated variants from fallbacks.

product-ops: customer comms: drafting an incident message for affected customers, ETA for full rollback/hard fix?

alice: timeline: mitigation applied at 1799991360, partial stabilization by 1799991500. Hotfix deployment expected in 20-30m. Recommend notifying P1 customers now and saying we are mitigating and rolling a fix.

ben: note for postmortem — we need: 1) stronger invariants in fallback selection (exclude deprecated variants), 2) ensure decision logs ALWAYS include route_tag and policy_id, 3) automated alert when decision_log truncation occurs.

carol: hotfix deployed to canary at 1799991700. Monitoring canary — no loop observed. Rolling to prod now.

sre-oncall: prod rollout complete at 1799991860. All clusters show steady metrics. Re-enabling smart-routing in 10m with stricter logging to validate.

eng-runtime: re-enable smart-routing with decision_log max_size=8192 and explicit exclude list for deprecated variants. Command: `curl -X POST -d '{"policy.smart_routing.enabled":true,"decision_log.max_size":8192}' https://api.internal.redwood/configs/cluster-us`

product-ops: customer message sent. Two customers acknowledged and said latency returned to normal. No data loss.

dinesh: creating PR for policy unit tests to cover empty matchers and fallback exclusions.

ben: adding runbook item: 'if route_tag missing, increase decision_log size and re-run trace-collector to reconstruct route map'.

sre-oncall: handing off to daytime on-call @alice at 1799991950. I'll stay available for questions. Incident classified P1, root cause: policy refactor + decision_log truncation -> fallback chose deprecated variant -> routing loop. Observability failures made diagnosis slower.

alice: taking over. Will drive postmortem and ensure follow-ups on runbook fixes, logging invariants, and customer RCA.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: INC-2026-447 at 1799991960. Summary: mitigation (pin + disable) -> hotfix -> re-enable with improved logging. Follow-ups assigned.
